spans.s:
रोरवण, अम्, n. (fr. the Intens.), Ved. a loud
cry or roaring, violent bellowing.

रोरवण रोरवण, रोरुवत्, रोरूय. See
p. 847, col. 3.

रोरुवत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. sounding or shouting
loudly, (referred by some to rt. 3. रु.)

रोरुवाण, अस्, आ, अम्, crying loudly, making a
loud cry or sound.

रोरूयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, crying loudly, making
a loud cry.
रोरुदत्, अन्, अती, अत्, weeping or wailing bitterly.

रोरुदत्; the nom. case sing. masc. ought rather
to be like that of the 3rd cl., in which case it must
be रोरुदत्.

रोरुदा, f. violent weeping, excessive lamentation.
—रोरुदा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, full of excessive lamen-
tation, weeping violently or intensely.

रोरुद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, weeping or crying
bitterly.

रोरुक रोरुक, N. of a country or of a
town.
